name: arch-advisor

interface.longDescription: Turns a Codex session into a full-time architect: it owns requirements, decomposition, specs and verification, delegates every implementation task to a cheaper Codex lane at a reasoning effort validated against that lane, and reviews the accumulated diff with codex review before reporting done. Lane models, legal effort rungs and wall-clock caps are configuration in lanes.json, not hardcoded.
defaultPrompt: Show me the profiles and lanes in effect with scripts/lane.sh list.
Act as the architect: design this, delegate the implementation to the routine lane, and verify with evidence before calling it done.
Review the accumulated diff before reporting done.

description: Architect-as-orchestrator routing with configurable Codex implementation lanes and validated per-task reasoning effort.
